description_en: Retrieves data from the space table in DevOps Insights for a specified enterprise
description_zh: 获取效能洞察中指定企业的space表数据
name: ExportInsightSpace

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can find this ID in the URL of your organization's Alibaba Cloud DevOps page. For example: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/#{organizationId}
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业 id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如 https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/#{organizationId}
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The start time for the query. The period between the start and end times must not exceed one year
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。和结束时间间隔不超过1年
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for the query. The period between the start and end times must not exceed one year
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。和开始时间间隔不超过1年
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. The response includes this token when more results are available
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page
parameters.name: max_results
